name: Neutral template brand. Copy this folder, rename it and change every value.
rules: One short rule per line, written for the animators and the illustrator. Example: no red.
Example: logo files are used as supplied and never redrawn.
Example: US English, sentence case, no emoji.

_fields.id: folder name; also written into the Eden usage tags (brand=<id>)
_fields.name: display name
_fields.palette: ten colour ROLES as #RRGGBB. ink: text and outlines. primary: main brand colour (large surfaces, chips). accent: vibrant brand colour (highlights, key objects). highlight: small pops (stamps, underlines, never body text). bg: canvas background. surface: card and window fill (usually white). line: borders and dividers. accentTint: pale accent for fills. bgTint: slightly darker than bg. muted: secondary text and disabled states. Legacy names used by older scenes: dark=ink, purple=primary, vibrant=accent, green=lime=highlight, light=bg, gray=line, lilac=accentTint, mist=bgTint, grayDark=muted.
_fields.font: family, weights and files (file per weight, looked up in <brand folder>/fonts/ first, then the template's fonts/). Inter (OFL) ships with the template.
_fields.logo: color: logo for light surfaces, white: logo for dark surfaces. Files in this brand folder (SVG or PNG). The aspect ratio is read from the loaded image. Omit a key to draw no logo of that kind.
_fields.style: default look. outline: outline width in px, 0 = flat with no strokes. shadow: 'offset' (solid offset copy) or 'soft' (blurred). radius: base corner radius in px. --style cartoon|flat on the scaffold overrides it (flat = outline 0 and soft shadow).
_fields.chrome: chapterPill: numbered chapter title top left during chapters. logo: logo top right during chapters. Both are hidden on the end card.
_fields.icons: source 'folder': at scaffold time every SVG in <brand folder>/icons/ is copied into the project's assets/icons/ (name them <id>_<color>.svg and <id>_<white>.svg, or just <id>.svg for a single-color set: it is then used for the color variant and a white copy is generated). source 'none' (default): no icons, assets/icons/ stays empty and scenes must not call K.icon, K.badge or K.chip with an icon. color and white are the file suffixes the engine loads: assets/icons/<id>_<color>.svg and <id>_<white>.svg.
_fields.spoken: optional [regex, replacement] pairs merged into project.json spoken (how the voice should say brand words), for example ["\\bAcme2\\b", "Acme two"]
_fields.align: optional expand entries merged into project.json align.expand ({token: [subtokens]}, matching the spoken forms)
_fields.rules: short brand rules; printed by the scaffold and copied into PLAN.md under Look
